claims.quote: The mouse mutant ducky, a model for absence epilepsy, is characterized by spike-wave seizures and cerebellar ataxia. A mutation in Cacna2d2, the gene encoding the alpha 2 delta-2 voltage-dependent calcium channel accessory subunit, has been found to underlie the ducky phenotype.

The mouse mutant ducky, a model for absence epilepsy, is characterized by spike-wave seizures and cerebellar ataxia. A mutation in Cacna2d2, the gene encoding the alpha 2 delta-2 voltage-dependent calcium channel accessory subunit, has been found to underlie the ducky phenotype.

claims.object_text: mRNA strongly expressed in cerebellar Purkinje cells
claims.quote: The alpha 2 delta-2 mRNA is strongly expressed in cerebellar Purkinje cells.

claims.object_text: abnormalities in Purkinje cell dendritic tree
claims.quote: We show that du/du mice have abnormalities in their Purkinje cell dendritic tree.

claims.object_text: premature stop codon predicting a truncated protein encoded by the first three exons of Cacna2d2
claims.quote: The mutation in alpha 2 delta-2 results in the introduction of a premature stop codon and predicts the expression of a truncated protein encoded by the first three exons of Cacna2d2, followed by 8 novel amino acids.

claims.object_text: mRNA and protein of predicted truncated transcript are expressed in du/du cerebellum and present in Purkinje cells
claims.quote: We show that both mRNA and protein corresponding to this predicted transcript are expressed in du/du cerebellum and present in Purkinje cells.

claims.object_text: increases peak current density of the Ca(V)2.1/beta(4) channel combination when co-expressed in vitro
claims.quote: Whereas the alpha 2 delta-2 subunit increased the peak current density of the Ca(V)2.1/beta(4) channel combination when co-expressed in vitro,
co-expression with the truncated mutant alpha 2 delta-2 protein reduced current density, indicating that it may contribute to the du phenotype.
